title: Batch immutable source reads
responsibility: Build a batched raw reader that shares cached promises with single-file reads.

inputs.name: githubRawMany.context
inputs.description: Source adapter, token and fetch options, shared raw-byte promise cache and repository/ref cache-key function.

outputs.name: githubRawMany
outputs.description: Reader that validates an exact commit and safe regular-file paths, deduplicates paths, loads batches of at most 64 and returns copied raw bytes without LFS expansion.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects invalid commits or paths, missing regular blobs and failed batch integrity checks; failed cached promises are removed.
